_note: Semantic/taste filter ON TOP of geometric seating (gen/semantics.py). Keys = keys of decorations_approved.json, plus 'pattern:<label>'. class: surface | structural | ornament | headpiece. transfer: broad | family-limited | novelty-only | headpiece-only. reject -> never, not even novelty (wins over prefer: Plague Doctor Mask is fantasy AND mask), prefer -> weight 1, allow -> ALLOW_W, any other NAMED family -> only in a novelty roll. unknownHost = weight on a host whose names give no family (opaque ids: Coii female_N, Seyph hats_N, ...). placement.anchor is checked against the measured source position by gen/demo_semantics.py. Host families come from author/vanilla names only (CLAUDE.md s3: shape-family membership is not evidence). Judgements are Claude's taste proposal, 2026-10-09; edit freely. Anchors: top-centre | top-side | front-mount | side-wall | crown-brim-junction | material-interior | face | head-top | head-ring; the first three were corrected to the measured source position (bird, cat ears, leaf sprig were mis-declared). concept: parts sharing a concept (colour variants of one drawing) are rolled as ONE attachment, then a variant is picked -- variants never multiply the concept's odds. 'device' (earmuffs, goggles, headphones, sunglasses, sleeping mask) is split from 'hair' (soft hair pieces): every ornament rejects devices, cat ears included (user 2026-10-10: ornaments reject earmuffs/goggles). placement.seat: surface (rests on the top) | side (tucked into the crown wall) ; placement.fit 'wrap': the part wraps a narrow tip and needs a host as narrow there.
